ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately >98% of visible surface contains low-intensity (black) pixels with minor high-intensity clusters limited to peripheral barnacles and water droplets.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the entire visible 2D plane; absence of high-contrast mottling or geometric white blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; calculated interior angle approximately 40-45 degrees with significant depth extending toward the leading edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected primarily on the trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude peaks with some smoothing due to perspective.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (yellowish-white) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes and along the lower peripheral boundaries.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint vertical linear pixel disruptions detected on the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both distal tips, significantly altering the natural geometric contour and providing high-contrast localized textural data.
other_distinctive_markers: Solid black pigmentation across 100% of the visible ventral fluke surface, excluding external parasites/barnacles.
